newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Perm to ask Yeltsin to allow Eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Russia Perm to ask Yeltsin to allow Eurobond issue.

text.p: Russia's Perm region asked President Boris Yeltsin to allow it to issue a Eurobond, chairman of the local parliament said on Tuesday.
"We are closer to an issue than any other region. That is why we asked for a separate decree, which would allow the Perm region administration to issue Eurobonds," Yevgeny Sapiro told Reuters.
Russian regions can only issue Eurobonds on the basis of presidential decrees, since general legislation has still not been passed.
In the spring, Yeltsin allowed the City of Moscow, St Petersburg and Nizhny Novgorod region to issue Eurobonds.
Sapiro said Yeltsin had ordered a special decree to be prepared that would regulate Eurobond issues for all regions.
Perm region plans to issue between $150 and $200 million in Eurobonds in December or January via Morgan Stanley.
It expects to get a credit rating in the autumn, when Russia's rating may be upgraded.
